hook: Confused by Bitcoin mining jargon? I built a website for you.

scenes.narration: It's for anyone curious how Bitcoin mining works, or weighing up digital mining, without the hype.
Inside are plain English guides on hashrate, difficulty, maintenance fees and mining pools.
There's a calculator with growth graphs, so you can test your own assumptions, including the downsides.
My favourite part is the My results page. It shows my own numbers. They are not typical, and can be lower.

cta: Find it at xylomining dot github dot I O. Link in my bio. Which page would you open first? Tell me below.
title: I Built a Website to Explain Bitcoin Mining in Plain English
description_body: Guides, a calculator with growth graphs, live channel stats and my own results page, all free to read.
